title: NIDDK: Healthy living with diabetes
text: Healthy eating and regular physical activity can help people manage diabetes. Work with a healthcare professional on a realistic eating and activity plan. A model score does not establish a diabetes diagnosis.

title: CDC: Diabetes and kidney disease - what to eat
text: Kidney nutrition depends on kidney function, treatment and individual needs. Discuss sodium, protein, potassium, phosphorus and fluid needs with a renal dietitian. Do not start salt substitutes, herbal supplements or restrictive diets without professional advice.

title: CDC: Chronic kidney disease, diabetes, and heart disease
text: Diabetes, kidney disease and heart disease share risk factors. Discuss blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, smoking and appropriate physical activity with a healthcare professional. Do not begin exercise during chest pain or other concerning symptoms.

title: NIDDK: Preventing chronic kidney disease
text: Managing diabetes and high blood pressure helps protect kidney health. Ask your clinician about appropriate kidney tests and an eating plan tailored to your needs. A single creatinine measurement or a model result cannot establish chronic kidney disease.
